findings.message: L22: 🟡 risk: Typo in condition — `toLowerCase()` should be `toLowerCase()` (correct method exists). Typo causes the condition to always be `false`, so DeepSeek model always takes the standard `OpenAI` path instead of `AzureOpenAI`, which may break Azure-hosted DeepSeek endpoints. Fix: change `toLowerCase()` to `toLowerCase()`.
